An '''island''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]]. It contained an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] codenamed "[[Cantham Cellar]]" and was located on the opposite side of the planet from [[New Aldera]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
